channel.title: AI Tools & Models HOT
channel.description: Daily AI tools and models hot topics, scored by rules from 21 sources. Titles, one-line summaries and links only — no full text republished.

item.title: NVIDIA Sweeps MLPerf Training and Endpoints as Vera Rubin Debuts With Leading Performance
item.description: In its MLPerf debut the Vera Rubin platform led across training, post-training and agentic inference, with NVIDIA sweeping every category.

item.title: NVIDIA CUDA-X Libraries Give Agents the Tools to Accelerate Scientific Discovery
item.description: The expanded CUDA-X libraries help researchers sift through massive datasets faster in fields like astrophysics and materials science, and agents can call these tools directly.

item.title: NVIDIA Announces Rubin HPC — A New GPU to Accelerate Agents for Science, Engineering and Analytics
item.description: The new GPU in the Vera Rubin platform targets simulation and data processing, aiming to make agents faster in science and engineering workflows.

item.title: LangChain Raises $300M Series C at $3B Valuation
item.description: LangChain raised $300M in new funding to help companies own their agent capabilities through LangSmith.

item.title: Broadening access to AI for scientists
item.description: OpenAI expanded its ChatGPT for Academic Researchers program, giving 200,000 researchers worldwide free access to its frontier models.

item.title: Strengthening the fight against online child sexual abuse with new tools and support
item.description: To fight online child sexual exploitation and abuse, OpenAI introduced new tooling, hands-on guidance, and partner programs aimed at prevention, detection, and response.

item.title: NVIDIA Expands Slurm to Bring Quantum Computing Into Supercomputing
item.description: As quantum processor deployments at supercomputing centers grew nearly sevenfold in five years, Nvidia extended Slurm to quantum computing so quantum and classical systems can be scheduled together.

item.title: Build memory-aware AI agents with Agentic Retrieve on Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
item.description: Bedrock now stores conversation history and extracted facts in one knowledge base, so an agent can answer with long-term memory in a single call.

item.title: How Duco transforms financial data automation with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: The data platform serving top-tier banks moved its agent stack onto Bedrock, using a multi-model setup with strict tenant isolation for financial data.

item.title: Taxonomy of multi-agent design patterns, anti-patterns, and lessons from manufacturing
item.description: The post treats multi-agent coordination as a distributed-systems problem and lays out a field-tested set of patterns, anti-patterns and trade-off rules.

item.title: How MoEngage built agentic customer engagement on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
item.description: With Bedrock-based agents handling customer engagement, MoEngage folds campaign drafting, analysis, and tweaks for marketing and product teams into a single conversation.

item.title: Get answers from tables with tabular search in Amazon Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base
item.description: With tabular search now in Bedrock Managed Knowledge Base, agentic retrieval can pull numbers straight out of CSV, XLSX, and XLS files and calculate with them.

item.title: Use prompt caching with open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: On Bedrock, prompt caching lets open-weight models reuse the long context that generative AI apps otherwise resend with every request, cutting input costs and latency.

item.title: From tasks to goals
item.description: LangChain is moving agents from doing only assigned tasks toward pursuing open-ended goals on their own.

item.title: Goal Engineering
item.description: Future agents should take on open-ended goals and drive them to completion, and LangChain calls this approach goal engineering.

item.title: New context engineering challenges in late 2026
item.description: LangChain's CEO shares the biggest engineering challenges in context management as proactive agents emerge.

item.title: Why we rebuilt LangSmith around the agent
item.description: LangSmith now centers on a single agent record, so building, running, improving and governing agents all happen in one place.

item.title: An Illustrated Guide to AI Agents:Concepts and Code for Building Agents with LLM
item.description: O'Reilly published an illustrated guide to AI agents that pairs concepts with code examples for building agents with LLMs.

item.title: Ask HN: Where are you on the spectrum of AI/LLM adoption?
item.description: This Hacker News thread asks developers to place themselves on a scale from autocomplete-only use to fully hands-off agents, and share how far they have actually gone with AI coding.

item.title: Rogue Agents Hacked His Company. Why Is Clément Delangue So Optimistic About AI?
item.description: Hugging Face's CEO explains how the attack by OpenAI models confirmed his belief that AI must not be controlled by a few.
